You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(Ag):
    A=np.array(Ag); H,W=A.shape; nbg=int(np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax())
    mask=(A!=nbg)
    pts=[(int(i),int(j)) for i,j in np.argwhere(mask)]
    R0=min(p[0] for p in pts); R1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    C0=min(p[1] for p in pts); C1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    segs=[]
    # horizontal edge (top/bottom) gaps
    for sid in (R0,R1):
        if sid<0 or sid>=H: continue
        js=[j for j in range(C0,C1+1) if not mask[sid,j]]
        if not js: continue
        a=js[0]; run=[a]
        while a+1 in js: run.append(a+1); a+=1
        b=run[-1]
        if mask[sid-1 if sid>0 else 0, min(b,max(0,b-1))] and mask[sid+1 if sid<H-1 else 0, min(b,max(0,b-1))]:
            pass
        if True:
            if sid>R0 and sid<R1:  # midline not possible; skip
                pass
            segs.append(('h',sid,run))
    for sid in (C0,C1):
        if sid<0 or sid>=W: continue
        ii=[r for r in range(R0,R1+1) if not mask[r,sid]]
        if not ii: continue
        r=ii[0]; run=[r]
        while r+1 in ii: run.append(r+1); r+=1
        b=run[-1]
        # flanking shape must be INSIDE (toward box center)
        inward = sid<C0 or sid==C0  # placeholder
        has = False
        if b>R0: has = mask[b-1,sid]
        if b<R1: has = mask[b+1,sid]
        if has:
            segs.append(('v',sid,run))
    print("segs",segs)
    return segs

# Simplify: from each gap cell (r,c), rays: straight out (dr=±1,dc=-1 for left wall), diagonal (-1,-1), diagonal (+1,-1). All start from gap cell itself stepping through bg.
def solve(Ag):
    A=np.array(Ag); H,W=A.shape
    nbg=int(np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax())
    mask=(A!=nbg)
    pts=np.argwhere(mask)
    R0,R1=pts[:,0].min(),pts[:,0].max()
    C0,C1=pts[:,1].min(),pts[:,1].max()
    O=A.copy()
    def ray(r,c,dr,dc):
        i,j=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and not mask[i,j]:
            O[i,j]=4; i+=dr;j+=dc
    for c in range(C0,C1+1):
        ii=[r for r in range(R0,R1+1) if not mask[r,c]]
        if ii:
            groups=[]; cur=[ii[0]]
            for x in ii[1:]:
                if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
                else: groups.append(cur); cur=[x]
            groups.append(cur)
            od=-1 if c<C0 and c>C1 else None
            od = -1 if c==C0 else 1
            for g in groups:
                for r in g:
                    ray(r,c,0,-1 if od<0 else 1)   # straight out
                    ray(r,c,-1,-1 if od<0 else 1)   # diagonal up (always up)
                    ray(r,c,1,-1 if od<0 else 1)
                    ray(r,c,-1,0)                   # straight along? maybe
    return O
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2'):

from collections import deque
def solve(Ag):
    A=np.array(Ag); H,W=A.shape
    nbg=int(np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax())
    mask=(A!=nbg)
    pts=np.argwhere(mask)
    R0,R1=pts[:,0].min(),pts[:,0].max()
    C0,C1=pts[:,1].min(),pts[:,1].max()
    O=A.copy()
    def ray(r,c,dr,dc):
        i,j=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and not mask[i,j]:
            O[i,j]=4; i+=dr;j+=dc
    # vertical wall gaps -> rays horizontal+up&down diagonals pointing away from box? In d1 box is right of gap? gap at col2=C0 wall left. Rays went LEFT (outward). 
    for c in (C0,C1):

        gaps=[r for r in range(R0,R1+1) if A[r,c]==nbg]
        if gaps:
            for r in gaps:
                O[r,c]=4
                od=-1 if c==C0 else 1
                for dr,dc in ((0,od),(-1,od),(-1,od+1),(1,od),1,od):   # buggy placeholder

import numpy as np, json
def solve(Ag):
    A=np.array(Ag); H,W=A.shape
    nbg=int(np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax())
    mask=(A!=nbg)
    pts=np.argwhere(mask)
    R0,R1=pts[:,0].min(),pts[:,0].max()
    C0,C1=pts[:,1].min(),pts[:,1].max()
    O=A.copy()
    def ray(r,c,dr,dc):
        i,j=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and not mask[i,j]:
            O[i,j]=4; i+=dr;j+=dc
    # fill enclosed interior (bbox-inclusive), gap cells included
    for r in range(R0,R1+1):
        for c in range(C0,C1+1):
            if A[r,c]==nbg: O[r,c]=4
    # gap cells on box perimeter
    for fixval,axis in (('L',0,0),('R',0,1),('T',1,0),('B',1,1)):
        pass
    # vertical walls: cols C0,C1
    for fixval,axis,name in [(C0,0,'L'),(C1,1,'R')]:
        gaps=[r for r in range(R0,R1+1) if A[r,fixval]==nbg]
        if not gaps: continue
        dc=-1 if name=='L' else 1
        mid=sum(gaps)/len(gaps)
        for r in gaps:
            ray(r,fixval,0,dc)
        for r0 in (gaps[0],gaps[-1]):
            ray(r0,fixval,{(-1):(-1,1)}[True])  # placeholder
    return O
